content.text: The backend has a separate endpoint for new-email confirmation (`email/confirm/new`), so the frontend most likely expects a separate page, probably `/confirm-new-email`.

candidates.explanation: The new-email verification link is built with the '/confirm-email' path, the same as the sign-up activation mail in userSignUp. The frontend page at that path calls POST auth/email/confirm, which confirms a sign-up hash. The email-change hash needs POST auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail), so following the link never completes the email change. The link should point to a separate page, '/confirm-new-email'.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'. The frontend page at that path must call POST auth/email/confirm/new.
